rules: R1 one-way: local is the only write source; gitee authoritative; github aligns; vector sea archives; hf mirrors
R2 same commit: S1/S2/S3 main must share one commit sha
R3 object hash acceptance: sha256 per file, sha16 per package
R4 read-only automation: scheduled tasks never push, never edit code
R5 conflict: stash -> rebase origin/main -> stash pop -> push; no force, no hard reset
R6 credential discipline: token read from local file, askpass temp deleted, never printed
R7 dimension gate before and after sync: A1 must stay 25/47/9
R8 silent-failure rule: push output is not proof, read back with ls-remote / hf commit sha
R9 one receipt per sync, never overwrite previous receipts
R10 degradation: one site down -> other four finish, receipt marks pending with reason
